# Goreview

> Goreview makes customized NFC and QR tap cards for Google, Facebook, and Instagram for businesses in the Philippines.

Goreview gives customers a direct path to a business's chosen Google review screen, Facebook Page, or Instagram profile. Customers tap an NFC-enabled phone or scan a QR code.

## Important facts

- Products: PHP 299 adhesive 3x4-inch tap cards for Google, Facebook, or Instagram; PHP 699 Google review standee.
- Tap-card minimum: 3 total, with any mix of the three platforms.
- Delivery: free within Cagayan de Oro for qualifying tap-card orders; shipping elsewhere is quoted separately.
- Support: lifetime support is included.
- Coverage: cards are made for businesses in the Philippines and can ship across the Philippines.
- Review policy: Goreview does not filter feedback, require a positive rating, offer incentives for reviews, or guarantee review volume, ratings, or search rankings.
- Brand relationship: Goreview is an independent product by Helbi Solutions and is not affiliated with Google or Meta.

## Canonical pages

- [Google review cards](https://goreview.site/google-review-card): what a Google review card is and how NFC and QR work together.
- [NFC Google review cards](https://goreview.site/nfc-google-review-card): how tap-to-review cards work and when QR is useful as a fallback.
- [Google review QR code cards](https://goreview.site/google-review-qr-code): how a QR code sends customers to a business review page.
- [Google review cards in the Philippines](https://goreview.site/google-review-card-philippines): local ordering, setup, shipping, and support information.
- [Facebook tap cards](https://goreview.site/facebook-tap-card): NFC and QR cards that open a Facebook Page or its reviews.
- [Instagram tap cards](https://goreview.site/instagram-tap-card): NFC and QR cards that open an Instagram profile.
- [Order inquiry](https://goreview.site/order): choose products and send an order inquiry; no online payment is collected.
